```{r}
# =========================
# A) Clean Weather Data
# =========================
df_weather <- read_csv("data/new_weather_2024.txt") %>%
  mutate(
    `觀測時間(hour)` = if_else(`觀測時間(hour)` == 24, 0, `觀測時間(hour)`),
    `降水量(mm)` = ifelse(`降水量(mm)` == "T", 0, `降水量(mm)`),
    `降水量(mm)` = as.numeric(`降水量(mm)`)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    station_pressure = `測站氣壓(hPa)`,
    temperature      = `氣溫(℃)`,
    humidity         = `相對溼度(%)`,
    wind_speed       = `風速(m/s)`,
    max_wind_speed   = `最大瞬間風(m/s)`,
    rainfall         = `降水量(mm)`,
    rain_duration    = `降水時數(h)`,
    solar_radiation  = `全天空日射量(MJ/㎡)`,
    uv_index         = 紫外線指數
  ) %>%
  select(-c(`最大瞬間風風向(360degree)`,
            `風向(360degree)`,
            `露點溫度(℃)`,
            `海平面氣壓(hPa)`,
            `總雲量(0~10)`,
            `能見度(km)`,
            `日照時數(h)`,
            `uv_index`,
            `rain_duration`))
```

```{r}

# =========================
# 2) (flow 與 info 同步)
# =========================

df_stat_info$sna <- gsub("^YouBike2\\.0_", "", df_stat_info$sna)

# =========================
# 3) 合併六個月份的 flow
# =========================
df_all <- bind_rows(
  #df_stat_flow_m3,
  #df_stat_flow_m4,
  #df_stat_flow_m5,
  df_stat_flow_m9,
  df_stat_flow_m10,
  df_stat_flow_m11
) %>% arrange(station, date, hour)


df_merged <- df_all %>%
  left_join(df_stat_info, by = c("station" = "sna"))


# =========================
# 5) 簡單缺值處理與刪除不需要的欄位（站點靜態欄）
# =========================
df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  select(-c(sarea, latitude, longitude, ar, sareaen, aren, act))
```




```{r}
# =========================
# 6) 新增4項時間特徵與淨借車量
# =========================

df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    hour = as.integer(hour),

    # 🚇 早晚尖峰
    is_peak_morning = hour %in% 7:9,     #上班尖峰
    is_peak_evening = hour %in% 17:19,   #下班尖峰
    is_peak_noon    = hour == 12,        #中午尖峰(短)
    is_peak_any     = is_peak_morning | is_peak_evening,

    # 🌙 深夜時段(低需求)
    is_night = hour %in% c(0:5, 23),


  
    
    # 🚲 淨借車量 = 借車 - 還車
    net_borrow = borrow_count - return_count
    
    
  ) 


```

```{r}

# 先把 date 都轉成 Date（用 ymd 可以吃到 2024/3/1 這種格式）
df_is_weekday <- df_is_weekday %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

df_weather <- df_weather %>%
  mutate(日期 = ymd(日期))

df_merged <- df_merged %>%

  # 6.1 合併 weekday / holiday 資訊
  left_join(df_is_weekday, by = "date") %>%   # 會多出 is_weekend, is_holiday

  # 6.2 合併天氣資料（已處理 24→0）
  left_join(
    df_weather,
    by = c("date" = "日期",
           "hour" = "觀測時間(hour)")
  )%>%
  mutate(
    is_dayoff = is_weekend | is_holiday
  )




df_merged <- df_merged %>% tidyr::drop_na()

readr::write_csv(df_merged, "df_merged.csv")
```












run RF model with cross validation(5-fold)
```{r}


library(data.table)
library(ranger)
library(future.apply)
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores())

set.seed(42)


# ==== 基本設定 ====
dt <- as.data.table(df_merged)
targets      <- c("borrow_count", "return_count","net_borrow")

features <- c(
  "is_peak_morning","is_peak_evening","is_peak_noon","is_peak_any","is_night",
  "is_weekend","is_holiday","is_dayoff",
  "station_pressure","temperature","humidity","wind_speed",
  "max_wind_speed","rainfall","solar_radiation",
  "total"
)
K <- 5  # blocked 5-fold，每折測試 20%


# 字串轉因子（一次處理）
for (nm in features) if (is.character(dt[[nm]])) dt[, (nm) := as.factor(get(nm))]

stations <- unique(dt$station)

# ==== 主程式：僅計算 pooled 指標 ====
out_list <- list()

for (st in stations) {
  d <- dt[station == st][order(date, hour)]
  n <- nrow(d)
  if (n < 80) next  # 測試集要有 20% 的量

  # 5 個連續測試區段
  cuts <- floor(n * (0:K) / K)
  test_ranges <- lapply(seq_len(K), function(i) c(cuts[i] + 1L, if (i < K) cuts[i+1L] else n))

  for (y in targets) {
    fml <- as.formula(paste(y, "~", paste(features, collapse = " + ")))

    # 累計器（只為 pooled 指標）
    sse_total <- 0
    sae_total <- 0
    test_amount <- 0
    sum_y  <- 0
    sum_y2 <- 0

    for (i in seq_len(K)) {
      te_st <- test_ranges[[i]][1]
      te_en <- test_ranges[[i]][2]
      te_idx <- te_st:te_en
      tr_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), te_idx)
      if (length(te_idx) < 5 || length(tr_idx) < 10) next

      tr <- d[tr_idx]
      te <- d[te_idx]

      rf <- ranger(
        formula     = fml,
        data        = tr,
        num.trees   = 1000,           # 較快、CV 夠用
        importance  = "none",
        num.threads = 0,             # 用滿 CPU
        respect.unordered.factors = "order",
        seed        = 42 + i
      )

      pred <- predict(rf, te)$predictions
      y_te <- te[[y]]

      err <- y_te - pred
      sse_total    <- sse_total + sum(err^2)
      sae_total    <- sae_total + sum(abs(err))
      test_amount <- test_amount + length(y_te)
      sum_y        <- sum_y + sum(y_te)
      sum_y2       <- sum_y2 + sum(y_te^2)
    }

    if (test_amount > 0) {
      ybar_all  <- sum_y / test_amount
      tss_total <- sum_y2 - test_amount * (ybar_all^2)
      R2    <- if (tss_total > 0) 1 - (sse_total / tss_total) else NA_real_
      RMSE  <- sqrt(sse_total / test_amount)
      MAE <- sae_total / test_amount
    } else {
      R2 <- RMSE <- MAE <- NA_real_
    }

    out_list[[paste(st, y, sep = " :: ")]] <- data.table(
      station = st, target = y,
      RMSE = RMSE,
      MAE = MAE,
      R2 = R2,
      test_amount = test_amount
    )
  }
}


metrics_summary_min <- rbindlist(out_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
df_metrics <- as.data.frame(metrics_summary_min)
print(df_metrics)
```
```{r}

readr::write_csv(df_metrics, "R2_CV.csv")


```
